terms.intro: Welcome to EarnLumens. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using any part of the EarnLumens platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions, as well as our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, you must not use the platform.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Service
sections.body: EarnLumens is a multi-tenant content platform built on the Stellar network. The main tenant is currently focused on financial education, and the platform enables new instances for other verticals through verification credentials. Creators can publish content (videos, audio, images, and resources) and set prices in XLM (Stellar Lumens). Users can purchase, view, and interact with this content.

sections.heading: 3. Account Registration
sections.body: You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

sections.heading: 4. Content and Intellectual Property
sections.body: Creators retain ownership of the content they publish on EarnLumens. By publishing, creators grant EarnLumens a non-exclusive, worldwide license to display, distribute, and promote the content on the platform. Users may not reproduce, redistribute, or resell purchased content without the creator's explicit permission.

sections.heading: 5. Payments and Transactions
sections.body: Payments made through EarnLumens constitute direct, exclusive, and independent transactions between the buyer and the creator, conducted using XLM on the Stellar network. EarnLumens acts solely as a technological platform for publication and technical intermediation, and does not intervene as a seller, buyer, agent, custodian, collection agent, fiduciary, or guarantor of any transaction between users. Prices are set exclusively by creators, and EarnLumens may apply applicable platform fees. Unless applicable law expressly provides otherwise, all sales are final, irrevocable, and non-refundable. If EarnLumens detects, receives reports of, or reasonably suspects fraud, abuse, breach, or any other unlawful conduct or conduct contrary to these Terms, it may temporarily or permanently suspend, restrict, or cancel the account of the creator involved and adopt any internal measures it deems reasonable. Notwithstanding the foregoing, EarnLumens assumes no obligation to intervene in disputes between users and does not guarantee, under any circumstances, the reversal of transactions, the recovery of assets, or the restitution, return, or refund of transferred funds. The user expressly acknowledges and accepts the inherent risks of blockchain transactions, including their potentially irreversible nature, as well as sole responsibility for network fees, address errors, amounts sent, or purchase decisions. The scope of the right you acquire with each purchase, and the procedure the platform follows when it removes purchased content (disputes, reinstatement, compensation), are described in the "Purchase terms" section below.

sections.heading: 6. Prohibited Conduct
sections.body: You agree not to: (a) upload harmful, illegal, or infringing content; (b) impersonate others; (c) attempt to exploit or disrupt the platform; (d) use automated tools to scrape or access the platform without authorization; (e) engage in any activity that violates applicable laws or regulations.

sections.heading: 7. Termination
sections.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account at any time if you violate these Terms. Upon termination, your right to use the platform ceases immediately, though provisions that by their nature should survive will remain in effect.

sections.heading: 8. Disclaimers
sections.body: The platform is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind. EarnLumens does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or usefulness of any content published by creators. We are not responsible for any losses resulting from Stellar network transactions.

sections.heading: 9. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, EarnLumens, its affiliates, directors, employees, contractors, and representatives shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, punitive, or any other damages arising from or related to the use or inability to use the platform, transactions between users, content published by creators, fraudulent or unlawful conduct of third parties, unmet commercial expectations, loss of data, loss of opportunity, lost profits, reputation, clientele, or for losses or damages arising from blockchain transactions, including those that are irreversible. In particular, EarnLumens shall not be liable for failure to deliver content, or for the quality, legality, authenticity, accuracy, or usefulness of content offered by creators, nor for returns, impossible chargebacks, claims between users, or loss of funds. In any event where, despite the foregoing, any liability of EarnLumens is legally determined, such liability shall be limited to the amount actually received by EarnLumens as a platform fee in the specific transaction that gave rise to the claim.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms at any time. We will endeavor to inform users of material changes through the platform, but it is your responsibility to review the Terms periodically. Your continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
sections.body: For questions about these Terms, please contact us at legal{'@'}earnlumens.org.

purchase.title: Purchase terms
purchase.intro: This section describes exactly what you acquire when you pay for content on this store, what can and cannot change afterwards, and how the platform handles removals, refunds and disputes. It applies to every store built on EarnLumens.

sections.heading: A. What you purchase
sections.body: Entry purchase: a perpetual, non-transferable right to access the entry. This right survives every creator-initiated change: unlisting, archiving, deleting, price changes, collection changes and new versions. You always keep the version you bought; adopting a newer approved version is voluntary. Collection purchase: a perpetual right to access everything the collection contained when you bought it, plus everything added to it afterwards — even if the creator later removes an item, archives, unpublishes or deletes the collection. Items removed before your purchase are not part of it. One right covers the whole collection; nothing is granted per item.
items: The main file of sold content is immutable: the creator cannot replace it without publishing a new version.
A newer approved version never replaces what you bought without your action; your library and player keep serving your version.
If this store is suspended, your library and everything you already bought remain available; only new purchases, tips and uploads are paused.

sections.heading: B. The only exception: platform removals
sections.body: Content that the platform removes for policy or legal reasons (illegal, stolen, or in justified breach of the rules) is blocked for everyone — buyers included, in all of its versions. In that case the platform automatically opens a dispute for every affected purchase and an administrator resolves it. Access is never removed by the creator, by a rejected edit, by a temporary review of reported content, or by the disappearance of the store, its domain or any intermediary.
items: Blocked content shows a notice with the reason and your dispute reference in your library.
If the removal is reversed, access returns automatically — your purchase record is not touched.

sections.heading: C. Your responsibilities
sections.body: Purchased content is for personal use only and may not be redistributed, resold or sublicensed. Where the platform offers a download, you are encouraged to keep local copies as protection against platform failure; backups are not a condition of your right.

sections.heading: D. Creator responsibilities
sections.body: Creators may change collections at any time (add or remove entries, change pricing). Removing an entry never removes it from existing buyers; it only stops future buyers from acquiring it. Unlisting, archiving or deleting content never revokes buyer access. Edits to published content are reviewed before they become visible; a rejected edit changes nothing for buyers or visitors. Creators must not use modifications to materially diminish the value of a purchase in bad faith; the platform may intervene.

sections.heading: E. Refunds
sections.body: Refunds are decided and processed by platform administrators only, as the outcome of a dispute. Stellar payments cannot be reversed; a refund is a compensating payment. Refunding a purchase revokes the corresponding right (entry or whole collection); a later re-purchase reactivates it.

sections.heading: F. Disputes (platform actions on purchased content)
sections.body: When purchased content is removed by the platform, a dispute is opened automatically for each affected purchase — including purchases made through a collection — grouped under the moderation case that caused it. Resolution is always an administrator's decision: refund, reinstate (access returns automatically, no change to the purchase record) or dismiss (violation confirmed, no refund owed). You are notified at each stage.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how EarnLumens collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly (account details, profile information) and information generated through your use of the platform (transaction history, viewing activity, device information).

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to: provide and improve our services, process transactions, communicate with you, ensure platform security, and comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: 3. Data Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with service providers who assist in operating the platform, or when required by law.

sections.heading: 4. Data Security
sections.body: We implement commercially reasonable security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.body: You may access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data by contacting us. We will make reasonable efforts to address your request within a reasonable timeframe.
